activity_summary: Alone, you refused to improve the answer you gave on the fifth. You named no house and no sum. You sent no letter.

facets.activity: Did not improve the answer from the fifth

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I did not answer well. I will not answer better tonight.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: No house. No figure. The beef was good, and that is not a letter.
